dataset_metadata.name: SkillReadiness-AI Synthetic Evaluation Benchmark
dataset_metadata.description: Synthetic multi-profile benchmark dataset for validating skill extraction precision/recall, gap identification, readiness calculation, and prerequisite ordering. This is a synthetic engineering evaluation dataset, not a human subjects learner trial.
